Get a list of all pairs of features

Source: R/AllGenerics.R
getFeaturePairs.Rd

Get a list of all pairs of features

Usage

getFeaturePairs(x, ...)

Arguments

x

input object

...

additional arguments for specific methods

Value

an list of two-column data.frames that represent all feature pairs.

Examples

x <- randomWeb(10)
getFeaturePairs(x)
